hypothesis: A shared short-prompt indicator plus an independent ten-token increment preserves separate fitting freedom without imposing the unsuccessful fixed ratio. This tests whether a hierarchical basis better explains shared startup-associated work.

pcvs.expression: len(request.prompt_token_ids) if request.prompt_token_ids is not None else 0
pcvs.name: prompt_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Retains the prompt-size term from the strongest candidates.

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and 9 <= len(request.prompt_token_ids) <= 10)
pcvs.name: early_short_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Provides a shared indicator for both elevated short-prompt states.

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and len(request.prompt_token_ids) == 10)
pcvs.name: ten_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Allows an independently fitted increment for the highest-cost state.

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and 12 <= len(request.prompt_token_ids) < 23)
pcvs.name: medium_prompt
